analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – focuses on practical AI skills for individuals and teams. The ‘creator-driven ecosystem’ is a bit vague but suggests a community aspect.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Large potential market for AI skills training, but competition is fierce. Enterprise programs add a layer of potential, but require significant sales effort.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Shows some progress (foundation built), but the timeline is aggressive, particularly for the AI Mentor and Agent Playground. The four-phase rollout is reasonable.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Subscription-based enterprise programs seem viable. Micro-courses and certifications could generate additional revenue, but success depends on content quality and market appeal.', 'Differentiation': '• The ‘personal AI mentor’ is a key differentiator, but the execution needs to be strong. The creator-driven aspect also needs to be well-defined.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• The global challenge suggests a plan for user engagement and demonstrating impact, but details are lacking. ‘Responsibility and ethics-minded providers’ is a vague mitigation.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Identifies key risks (AI integration, UX, accessibility) and proposes reasonable mitigations. Monthly updates and early testing are good practices.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Stronger and more focused value proposition – addressing the critical problem of verifiable ethical sourcing and combating misinformation. The ‘heirloom-quality’ concept is intriguing.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Significant market demand driven by increasing consumer and regulatory pressure on ethical supply chains. Target users (procurement teams, NGOs) are well-defined.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• The lightweight, privacy-first approach seems more realistic and achievable. The focus on fingerprints and verification widgets is a sensible strategy.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Subscription model is logical and scalable. The free trial and optional upgrades are standard practices.', 'Differentiation': '• The combination of physical goods and permanent, verifiable digital provenance is a genuinely unique differentiator. Addresses a fundamental problem in the digital world.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• The focus on creating a permanent record offers a clear path to demonstrating impact and building trust.  The widget integration is a strong element.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Risks related to data privacy and security are acknowledged. The emphasis on anonymity is a good mitigation strategy.'}}
